categories.name: wallet
categories.evidence: Matches the 'Wallet' label and alters internal locking and callback behavior in src/wallet/scriptpubkeyman.cpp.
categories.rationale: Converting DescriptorScriptPubKeyMan to a non-recursive mutex clarifies lock hierarchy and avoids re-entrancy deadlocks during synchronous callbacks. The work contributes to the long-standing goal of eliminating recursive mutexes across the codebase (#19303) without altering user-facing wallet functionality.
